The National Socialist Program , also known as the Nazi Party Program , the 25-point Program or the 25-point Plan ( German : 25-Punkte-Programm ), was the party program of the National Socialist German Workers' Party (NSDAP). Adolf Hitler announced the party's program on 24 February 1920 before approximately 2,000 people in the Munich Festival of the Hofbräuhaus . The National Socialist Program originated at a DAP congress in Vienna , then was taken to Munich by the civil engineer and theorist Rudolf Jung , who having explicitly supported Hitler had been expelled from Czechoslovakia because of his political agitation.
